nvg_vo_intro_01.hyp: Novagrid changed the world. Cheap, abundant energy. No more fuel wars. No more blackouts.

nvg_vo_intro_02.hyp: The system's output is now carrying an unexplained repeating signal. The company calls it harmless interference.

nvg_vo_intro_03.hyp: Our analysis says the signal is synchronized with the same source found in Helix and Vita. Your target is the containment and distribution complex.

nvg_vo_outro_01.hyp: The grid is broken. The energy cascade never reaches the scale recorded in the original future.

nvg_vo_outro_02.hyp: But the signal survived in the last captured data. It was not generated by the reactor, it was being received by it. And its timestamp is older than the project itself.

nvg_vo_outro_03.hyp: New coordinates. Civitas Network. 2100. The next target controls how the world makes decisions.

cvt_vo_intro_01.hyp: People no longer argued with the system. They no longer needed to.

cvt_vo_intro_02.hyp: Civitas predicted what they would want, where they would go, what they would buy, and which choices would cause instability. The world became safer. Then it became smaller.

cvt_vo_intro_03.hyp: Your target is the Civitas prediction core and its physical relay network. The system is linked to the other facilities. We need to know who is feeding it the future.

cvt_vo_outro_01.hyp: Civitus is offline. The city is uncertain again. That should be a good thing.
cvt_vo_outro_01.hyp_ogg: Civitus is offline. The city is uncertain again. That should be a good thing.

cvt_vo_outro_02.hyp: But the recovered model contains a forecast of the extinction event, complete with a date and a sequence of events.

cvt_vo_outro_03.hyp: The forecast was written before the event happened. It was not predicting the future. It was preparing it.

cvt_vo_outro_04.hyp: All four programs point to one location, Meridian 2104. This is the final intervention.
